notes.title: "Vampire: The Masquerade — Sins of the Sires" Livestream
notes.content:
Come join Huddy von Schland (@huddyvonschland) as she streams the demo of [i]Vampire: The Masquerade — Sins of the Sires[/i], by Natalia Theodoridou (@natalia_theodor).

[i]Sins of the Sires[/i], releasing March 24th, is the latest in the World of Darkness interactive novel anthology produced by Choice of Games.

Who will you use, who will you help, and who will you prey on? Will you topple the old Prince Peisistratos? Will you betray your boss when your lost sire returns? What miseries will you inflict to fight for a fairer, more humane world?
